literature_notes: All eight ledger lines (L1–L8) describe a single experimental intervention: an HA-FLAG dual tag knocked in at the C-terminus of full-length PCDH19 (before the stop codon, i.e., after residue 1148) via CRISPR/Cas9 HDR in human hESCs (PMC11024992) and in a knock-in mouse model (PMC11408250, PMC11037505). PCDH19 is a single-pass type-I transmembrane protein with its C-terminus entirely intracellular (residues 702–1148). Residue 1148 (L) is the last intracellular residue; the tag sits after it, facing the cytoplasm. No ledger line describes any tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon insertion, or domain-insertion at any extracellular position — neither at the mature N-terminus (residue 22) nor anywhere in the large ectodomain (residues 22–678). Because the sole evidenced insertion is intracellular, zero extracellular surface tag sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: HA-FLAG tag knocked in after residue 1148 (before stop codon) at the intracellular C-terminus of full-length PCDH19; confirmed functional by immunoprecipitation and immunocytochemistry in neural rosettes and cortical organoids.
